name.ja: ＲＥ/100 1/100 ガンイージ・プロトタイプ（ロールアウトカラー）

description.ja: 反 撃 の 徒 、 立 つ ―
description.en: Counterattackers stand -

description.ja: 『機動戦士Ｖガンダム ニューモビルスーツバリエーション』より、
description.en: From "Mobile Suit V Gundam New Mobile Suit Variation"

description.ja: リガ・ミリティアが開発した量産型ＭＳ「ガンイージ」のプロトタイプ（ロールアウト時）をＲＥ/100シリーズで商品化。
description.en: Commercialized the prototype (at rollout) of the mass-produced MS "Gunigi" developed by Riga Militia as the RE/100 series.

description.ja: 特徴的な機体色を成形色で再現し、武装化前の頭部形状を新規造形で再現。設定画稿に合わせた新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: The characteristic body color is reproduced with molding color, and the head shape before weaponization is reproduced with new modeling. A newly designed water transfer decal that matches the setting drawing is included.

description.ja: ●　設定画稿の機体色を、成形色で色分け再現
description.en: ● Color-coded reproduction of the aircraft color in the setting draft using molding colors

description.ja: 機体ロールアウト時のガンダリウム合金が地肌のまま、未塗装状態の色味を成形色で再現。
description.en: When the aircraft is rolled out, the Gundarium alloy remains as it is, and the color of the unpainted state is reproduced in the molded color.

description.ja: 手甲や足の甲にあたる装甲もパーツ分割による色分け再現。
description.en: The armor on the backs of the hands and the backs of the feet is also reproduced in color by dividing the parts.

description.ja: ●　武装化前の頭部形状を新規造形で再現
description.en: ● Reproduce the head shape before weaponization with new modeling

description.ja: 頭部バルカンやウェポンコンテナなどの固定武装搭載前の形状を再現。頭部パーツは新規パーツを採用。
description.en: Reproduce the shape before mounting fixed weapons such as head Vulcan and Weapon container. New parts are used for the head parts.

description.ja: ●　設定画稿に準じた、新規デザインのデカールが付属！
description.en: ● Comes with a newly designed decal based on the setting drawing!

description.ja: 設定画稿特有のラインマークやコーションマークなどを収録した、新規デザインの水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: Comes with a newly designed water transfer decal that includes line marks and caution marks unique to the setting draft.

description.ja: ●　ガンイージの各種武装類が付属！
description.en: ● Various weapons of Gunigi are included!

description.ja: ビーム・ライフル、ビーム・バズーカといったガンイージの標準武装類が付属！
description.en: Gunieji's standard weapons such as beam rifle and beam bazooka are included!

description.ja: 付属武装：ビーム・ライフル　／　ビーム・サーベル ／ ビーム・バズーカ　／　ビーム・シールド
description.en: Attached weapons: Beam Rifle / Beam Saber / Beam Bazooka / Beam Seal

description.ja: １／１００スケール組み立て式プラモデル
description.en: 1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model

description.ja: 対象年齢：１５才以上
description.en: Target age: 15 years old and above

description.ja: 製品素材：ＰＳ・ＰＥ・ＰＥＴ
description.en: Product material: PS/PE/PET

description.ja: ・組み立てに接着剤は使用しません
